📰 RAG from Scratch: Grounding LLMs in Your Data

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) revolutionizes LLM accuracy by fetching external, relevant data. This approach combats hallucinations, ensuring LLMs deliver precise, up-to-date answers for critical engineering applications.
